description: This is a unit test class for testing the ResetConnectionLogs class within the connectivity commands package of the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies equals/hashCode implementations, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and null input handling.

classes.name: ResetConnectionLogsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ResetConnectionLogs, testing equality, immutability, JSON conversion, and null handling.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that ResetConnectionLogs correctly implements hashCode and equals methods using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ResetConnectionLogs instances are immutable and that ConnectionId is also immutable.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullConnectionId
methods.description: Ensures that passing null as ConnectionId throws a NullPointerException with an appropriate message.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Validates that a JSON object correctly deserializes to a ResetConnectionLogs instance matching the expected object.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures that the ResetConnectionLogs instance serializes back to its original JSON representation.
